artikel.judul: Coffee in Rhythm: Tanamera Coffee at Soundrenaline Sana Sini Jakarta 2026
artikel.ringkasan: Cuplikan isi: Tanamera joined Soundrenaline Sana Sini Jakarta 2026 for two days of sound, energy, and good coffee. Day 1 brought our signature selections and the Cold Brew Crew — easy sips for moving between sets. Day 2 added Tanamera Draft Coffee, poured fresh from the tap, for something even easier to grab between songs. From the opening act to the last encore, every cup found its place in the crowd. Because good coffee doesn't just belong in a café — it belongs wherever people gather. Taste the Origins. Feel the Rhythm.

artikel.judul: Draft Coffee Poolside — Grand Splash Vol. 5 at Grand Hyatt Jakarta
artikel.ringkasan: Cuplikan isi: Tanamera Coffee joined Grand Splash Vol. 5 at Grand Hyatt Jakarta, bringing Draft Coffee to the pool. From afternoon into evening, guests kept it going with Draft Coffee on hand — smooth, easy to drink, and a different way to enjoy specialty coffee outside the café. For Tanamera, it's never just about coffee. It's a chance to show up somewhere new and meet people who haven't tried us yet. Good music, great energy, and coffee served differently. Taste the Origins. Share the Experience.

artikel.judul: Konsumsi Kopi Indonesia Tembus 1 Kilogram Per Kapita, Catat Sejarah Baru
artikel.ringkasan: Cuplikan isi: Setelah lebih dari satu dekade berada di angka ratusan gram per kapita per tahun, akhirnya Indonesia berhasil menembus batas psikologis yang selama ini menjadi “angka keramat” konsumsi kopi nasional: 1,04 kilogram per kapita per tahun, atau setara dengan 0,27 cangkir kopi per kapita setiap hari.
